remarks: Enjoy effortless city living in this lovely 7th floor, 1 bedroom, 1 bath condo at Delaware Towers. This pet friendly condominium offers a 24-hour door attendant and covered parking all in a prime location within walking distance of the shops, restaurants and amenities of the Elmwood Village and Delaware District. Step inside to a tiled entryway with a spacious storage closet perfect for adding in-unit laundry.  The entryway opens to a bright, inviting living area featuring new flooring and sliding glass door leading to an east facing covered patio with sweeping views leading to the galley-style kitchen offering an electric cooktop, microwave, wall oven and refrigerator.  Off the hallway you will find the full bath featuring a tub/shower combination and vanity with additional storage as well as the generously sized bedroom provideing ample closet space. Additional conveniences include laundry facilities and dedicated storage in the basement. The HOA fee includes heat adding to the ease of condominium living. Enjoy comfort, convenience and a fantastic location in one of Buffalo’s most desirable areas!
